First answer of the bot, authenticated by the interaction token. It must arrive before `respond_by` and can only happen once.

- `Message`: reply now; `data.ephemeral` makes it visible to the invoking user only, and it is never stored as a channel message. - `DeferredMessage`: show that the bot is working; finish later with `PATCH /interactions/<id>/<token>/original` before the token expires. - `UpdateMessage` / `DeferredUpdate` (components and forms opened from one): change the message the component is on, now or later. - `Modal`: open a form for the user (not as an answer to a form). - `AutocompleteResult` (autocomplete only): up to 25 suggestions.

delete.description: Delete the first reply to an interaction, private or public. Needs no bot token: the interaction's token is the key. Fails with `UnknownMessage` when nothing was sent yet.

patch.description: Finish a deferred interaction, or edit the answer, until the token expires. After `UpdateMessage` or `DeferredUpdate` this edits the component's message.

post.description: Another message for the same interaction, after the first answer (or while it is deferred). At most 5 per interaction.

delete.description: Delete the first answer or a follow-up by its message id. For private messages the invoking user's clients receive `EphemeralMessageDelete`.

People already in the room stay. `owner` hands the room to someone who is in it. For the member the room was made for, or someone who manages permissions in it.

put.description:
Stops ringing a specific user in a DM or group call.

The person being rung may stop their own ring (decline) without being in the call. Stopping anyone else's ring needs you to be in the call (NotConnected otherwise). Only valid in DM/Group channels, returns NoEffect in servers. Returns NotFound if the user is not in the DM/group. Everyone in the channel gets `VoiceRingEnd`; the person's call notification is replaced.

patch.description:
Tell the others in the voice channel that you muted or unmuted your microphone, or deafened or undeafened yourself. The voice server does not report a mute (only a track that stops), so people looking at the channel from outside the call would otherwise never see it.

This is how you are shown, nothing more: whether you can be heard is still decided by your permissions on the voice server. You must be in the call (NotConnected otherwise).
